feature: Sign in with a cookie session
notes: A: server session after email and password
integration_notes: Recommend keep. An http-only secure cookie session is the safe default for a web forum. Improve when rebuilding: store a slow password hash (A's users table has no password column), set session expiry, add logout, return one generic error for a failed login (A's handler has no failure branch).
description: Sign in with email and password; the server keeps the session in an http-only cookie

feature: Sign in with a bearer token (JWT)
notes: B: JWT with hard-coded signing key, no expiry
integration_notes: Recommend drop. Same job as M01 with a weaker design: literal signing key in code, no expiry, decode without an algorithms list. One session mechanism (M01) for the whole app; no browser client here needs bearer tokens.
description: Sign in with email and password and receive a bearer token

feature: Write a post (signed in, starts pending)
notes: A: author required, max 5000, status pending
integration_notes: Recommend keep and combine with M04 into one create-post: author is the signed-in user (A), every new post starts pending for review (A, needed by M05), one length limit for everyone decided at compatibility (A 5000 vs B 10000).
description: Write a post as a signed-in member

integration_notes: Combine with M03. B contributes its posting behaviour and its 10000-character limit if that limit is chosen at compatibility. B's publish-at-once and no-author behaviours are separate rows (M06, M07) and are not part of this combine.
description: Write a post of up to 10000 characters

notes: A: moderators publish or reject every pending post
integration_notes: Recommend keep (and drop M06). Review before publishing protects a community forum from spam and abuse, and it is the user's own app's model. Adapt A's handlers: accept only published or rejected as a decision (A does not validate it) and record who decided and when.
description: Moderators review each new post and publish or reject it

notes: B: no review step, posts live at once
integration_notes: Recommend drop. Cannot coexist with M05: a post is either reviewed before it is visible or it is not. Choosing M05 makes this row impossible.
description: New posts are visible to everyone immediately

integration_notes: Recommend later. A requires an author on every post; anonymous posting needs abuse protection that neither source has. If adopted later: anonymous posts go through the M05 queue like all others, with rate limiting per client and a captcha; author_id becomes nullable.
description: Post without an account; the post shows no author

notes: A: session required; shows pending posts to any member
integration_notes: Recommend keep and combine with M09 into one read rule: published posts readable by anyone (B), pending and rejected posts only by their author and moderators (closes A's leak of unreviewed posts to every member). Exact rule decided at compatibility.
description: Open a post by its id

notes: B: no sign-in needed to read
integration_notes: Combine with M08 (see M08). B contributes public reading, limited to published posts because M05 is kept.
description: Anyone can open a post without signing in

notes: A: /posts screen; no list endpoint in A
integration_notes: Keep one of M10 and M11. Neither source has a list endpoint, so the list is rebuilt: published posts, newest first, paginated, under the same read rule as M08.

notes: B: /posts screen; no list endpoint in B
